title: Story Bank
description: Reusable STAR(+Reflection) interview stories built from Master Resume Achievements. English. Situation, task, action and result use only facts and numbers from the cited Achievements; the reflection is the user's own words.

built_from.description: Every Master Achievement id considered when the bank was last built; the bank is stale when the master has ids not in this list

themes.description: Behavioral themes it answers, e.g. technical-challenge, conflict, failure, leadership, cross-team

questions.description: Sample interview questions this story answers

achievements.description: Master Achievement ids the story draws on

reflection.description: What the user learned or would do differently, in their words from the interview; never invented

open_questions.description: Context still to ask the user about
